longitude: Longitude of the district. More negative means further west.
latitude: Latitude of the district. Higher means further north.
housing_median_age: Median age of the houses in the district, in years (capped at 52).
total_rooms: Total number of rooms in the district.
total_bedrooms: Total number of bedrooms in the district. Can be left empty.
population: Number of people who live in the district.
households: Number of households in the district.
median_income: Median household income, in tens of thousands of US dollars (3.5 means $35,000).
ocean_proximity: Rough location of the district compared to the ocean or the bay.
median_house_value: Median house value in the district, in US dollars, 1990 (capped at 500,001).
